title: Omics datasets can bridge the gap between tumor biology and patient care
content:
by Ji-Ting Huang, Lei-Jie Dai, Ding Ma, Zhi-Ming Shao

Large-scale omics datasets from tumor samples are becoming ever easier to generate and analyze. As technology continues to push forward, how can this data be leveraged to help patients in the clinic? Large-scale omics datasets from tumor samples are becoming ever easier to generate and analyze. This Perspective looks at how, as technology continues to push forwards, multiomics data be leveraged to help patients in the clinic.
author: Ji-Ting Huang
